SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
    )
) AS catalog_sales_filtered
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON catalog_sales_filtered.cs_order_number = catalog_returns.cr_order_number AND catalog_sales_filtered.cs_item_sk = catalog_returns.cr_item_sk
JOIN warehouse ON catalog_sales_filtered.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales_filtered.cs_item_sk
WHERE item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
